title: Detail drawer: auto-layout multi-column + NavigationOverlay integration
body:
Detail panels are locked to single-column layout and the console hardcodes a `Sheet` drawer, bypassing the platform's `NavigationOverlay` and `ViewNavigationConfig` entirely. ### Auto-layout for DetailView/DetailSection New `packages/plugin-detail/src/autoLayout.ts` with detail-specific column inference (wider thresholds than forms since detail views are read-only): | Field count | Columns | |---|---| | ≤3 | 1 | | 4–10 | 2 | | 11+ | 3 | Wide field types (`textarea`, `markdown`, `html`, `grid`, `rich-text`) auto-span the full row. User-set `columns` always takes priority. ```ts // DetailSection now auto-infers when columns is omitted const { fields: layoutFields, columns: effectiveColumns } = applyDetailAutoLayout( section.fields, section.columns // undefined → auto-infer ); ``` - `DetailSection` calls `applyDetailAutoLayout` to infer columns and apply wide-field spanning - `DetailView` no longer forces `columns: 2` fallback for direct fields — delegates to auto-layout ### Console: Sheet → NavigationOverlay - Replaced hardcoded `Sheet`/`SheetContent` with `NavigationOverlay` + `useNavigationOverlay` hook - Navigation mode driven by `objectDef.navigation` config (defaults to `{ mode: 'drawer' }`) - Removed `columns: 1` from the detail section schema — fields now flow into 2–3 columns automatically - URL-based `recordId` synced bidirectionally with overlay state ```tsx // Before: hardcoded drawer // After: platform-driven, configurable const detailNavigation: ViewNavigationConfig = objectDef.navigation ?? { mode: 'drawer' }; const navOverlay = useNavigationOverlay({ navigation: detailNavigation, ... }); {(record) => } ``` ### Tests 25 new tests: 20 unit tests for `inferDetailColumns`, `isWideFieldType`, `applyAutoSpan`, `applyDetailAutoLayout` + 5 integration tests verifying DetailSection grid class output for various field counts.
Original prompt > > ---- > > *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* > > 右侧详情 Drawer 支持 auto-layout 多列并开放左右/弹窗/页面等导航模式配置 > ## 问题描述 > > 目前 Console（以及部分插件应用）展示行详情时，均是右侧弹出的单列表单／详情面板。实现方式一般是： > - 行点击后用 `recordId` 写入 URL 查询参数 > - 自行渲染 ``，如 apps/console/src/components/ObjectView.tsx 第 400–431 行 > > 存在两个核心问题： > 1. **单列布局体验差：** 字段多时详情面板页面过长、可用空间浪费严重（实际 drawer 宽度约 600px~700px，完全可以支持 2-3 列布局） > 2. **平台导航模式能力未利用：** navigation 配置支持 drawer/modal/page/split... 等多种类型，但 Console/业务代码绕过平台配置，直接写死右侧 Drawer > > > > ## 优化建议 > - 改造所有右侧栏详情面板，统一使用平台的 `NavigationOverlay`/`DetailView`，columns 留空或交由 auto-layout 推断，支持 2/3 列合理排布（参考 ModalForm 自动分栏） > - 支持通过 ViewNavigationConfig 完全配置详情打开模式（drawer/modal/page/split/popover/新标签/不响应），不应在应用层写死 > - 例: navigation: { mode: 'drawer', width: '700px' } 或 { mode: 'modal', width: 800 } > - 业务/Console/App 层不得再自行包 Drawer+DetailView，全部走平台能力 > - 默认详情列数同 auto-layout 推断（如字段≤3单列，4-10两列，更多可 3 列等），允许业务 schema 覆盖。 > > ## 受益 > - 用户体验极大提升，浏览大对象时更高效 > - 导航和布局方式高度可配置，平台统一能力、运维极其便捷 > - 与表单弹窗改造（#620）配合，实现"全平台导航与布局唯一入口" > > ## 相关 > - objectstack-ai/objectui#620 表单弹窗统一入口方案 > > ## Comments on the Issue (you are @copilot in this section) > > > >
